correctness.rationale: With explicitly normalized spin-raising modes, azimuthal orthogonality diagonalizes the compression. Reflection pairs opposite m; integrating the difference of the two squared eth factors collapses to the equatorial boundary value. The exact associated-Legendre value produces central binomial factors. The proven ratio of consecutive positive shifts is strictly below one via the identity (2a-1)(b+1)-a(2b+1)=k-1, proving every maximizer/multiplicity. A second-shift ratio proves the best possible global deficit; central-binomial recursion and Stirling prove strict degree law. Independent-from-formula Rodrigues-polynomial exact integrals (120 checks), Gauss–Legendre quadrature/traces (868), and rational spectrum/gaps (1198) passed. Finite computations are not used as the universal proof.

value.rationale: Fixed-degree helicity spherical harmonics are canonical blocks for vector/tensor polar localization; the natural first question is their sharp hemisphere energy fraction. This resolves the whole all-degree family exactly, rather than only an arbitrary numerical invariant: every eigenvalue and degeneracy, unique extremizers, exact second spectral gap, quantitative stability, and strict degree decay. The binomial order proof is structural and the special case is not claimed to settle arbitrary cap or multi-degree Slepian problems.
